02 / THE FIELD MANUAL

              
A method to the Joe.

            

            
JoeLang favors a readable question over a clever shortcut: which object receives this message, and what should it remember afterward?

          

          

            

              01
              
Name the thing.

              
Begin with joebject. A Joebject owns its state and explains the role it plays in the program.

              
joebject Lantern { ... }

            

            

              02
              
Give it state.

              
Use has for values that belong to the object. State stays close to the behavior that changes it.

              
has charge = 3

            

            

              03
              
Send a message.

              
Use a dot to ask an instance to act. The receiver is visible, so changes never come from nowhere.

              
lantern.use_one_charge()
